title: Dangerous Liaisons
note: mentioned by Bill during High Fidelity ep, says it's on the 2026 rewatchables slate; mentioned again during The Big Picture 1988 draft, says it's on the rewatchables list 'at some point'
plot: In 18th century France, Marquise de Merteuil asks her ex-lover Vicomte de Valmont to seduce the future wife of another ex-lover of hers in return for one last night with her. Yet things don’t go as planned.
